draw_keypoints_on_image: draw colored keypoints on an image from a numpy array of 2D coordinates with optional confidence scores
draw_bbox_on_image: draw a colored bounding box rectangle on an image given top-left and bottom-right coordinates
draw_raw_bboxes_on_image: draw multiple bounding boxes on an image from a list of x, y, width, height tuples
draw_body_bbox_on_image: draw body bounding boxes on an image from a list of body detection results with None filtering
draw_arm_pose_on_image: draw left and right arm keypoints on an image from a list of body pose arrays
